name: MAGMA
recent: Magma 终止了以 RM61m 收购沙巴酒店的计划，同时以 RM2.8m 收购 Christine's Bakery 并完成 RM63m 出售 Heritage Lane 20% 股权。公司也通过私募分批集资约 RM23m，最新季度仍录得亏损。
notable: 终止以 RM61m 收购沙巴酒店的计划，双方同意终止 Heads of Agreement。
以 RM2.8m 现金收购 Christine's Bakery 全部股权，由 80% 持股的 Magma Food Ventures 执行。
完成以 RM63m 出售 Heritage Lane 20% 股权予 Harum Aspirasi。
risks: 私募分三批发行共 82,560,400 股新股，对现有股东权益有摊薄影响。
最新季度净亏损 RM7.294m，净利率为 -116.5%。
董事在闭门期内有买卖公司股份的意向申报。
earnings: 2026年3月31日季度营收 RM6.261m，环比增长 235.2%，同比微降 1.2%；净亏损 RM7.294m，净利率 -116.5%，上一季度净利率为 19.0%。

recent_en: Magma terminated a planned RM61m acquisition of a Sabah hotel, while acquiring Christine's Bakery for RM2.8m and completing the RM63m disposal of its 20% stake in Heritage Lane. The company also raised about RM23m via private placement tranches and remained loss-making in the latest quarter.
notable_en: Terminated the planned RM61m acquisition of a Sabah hotel, with both parties agreeing to end the Heads of Agreement.
Acquiring the entire equity interest in Christine's Bakery for RM2.8m cash via 80%-owned Magma Food Ventures.
Completed the RM63m disposal of its 20% stake in Heritage Lane to Harum Aspirasi.
risks_en: Private placement of 82,560,400 new shares across three tranches dilutes existing shareholders.
Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM7.294m with a net margin of -116.5%.
Directors filed intentions to deal in company shares during the closed period.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 31 March 2026, revenue was RM6.261m, up 235.2% QoQ but down 1.2% YoY; net loss was RM7.294m with a net margin of -116.5%, versus a net margin of 19.0% in the prior quarter.
